findings.title: Null check in AccessTokenContext constructor checks grantType instead of rawTokenId
findings.body: In the `AccessTokenContext` constructor, line 73 calls `Objects.requireNonNull(grantType, "Null rawTokenId not allowed")` instead of checking `rawTokenId`. As a result, a null `rawTokenId` is accepted by the constructor and stored in `this.rawTokenId`, rather than failing fast with the intended `NullPointerException`.

findings.title: isAccessTokenId matcher uses wrong substring indices and inverted equality check
findings.body: `AssertEvents.isAccessTokenId` checks the grant shortcut with `if (items[0].substring(3, 5).equals(expectedGrantShortcut)) return false;` (and does not check that `items[0].length() == 6`). In `DefaultTokenContextEncoderProvider`, the 6-character prefix is encoded as sessionType (indices 0..2), tokenType (indices 2..4), and grantType (indices 4..6). Using `substring(3, 5)` extracts the second character of tokenType and the first character of grantType (e.g. `"ta"` for `"onrtac"`), and the condition returns `false` when it equals `expectedGrantShortcut` instead of when it does not equal `expectedGrantShortcut`. The matcher therefore only passes by accident because `substring(3, 5)` almost never matches the expected grant shortcut, and it fails to verify that the token ID actually contains the expected grant shortcut.

findings.title: Javadoc for OAuth2GrantTypeFactory.getShortcut() says 3-letters shortcut instead of 2 characters
findings.body: The Javadoc on `OAuth2GrantTypeFactory.getShortcut()` states `@return usually like 3-letters shortcut of specific grants`, whereas `DefaultTokenContextEncoderProvider` requires the entire encoded context prefix (`sessionType` + `tokenType` + `grantType`) to be 6 characters long (`encodedContext.length() != 6`) and parses the grant shortcut as `encodedContext.substring(4, 6)` (2 characters). Any `OAuth2GrantTypeFactory` implementation returning a 3-letter shortcut as suggested by the Javadoc will cause `getTokenContextFromTokenId` to throw `IllegalArgumentException`.
